question: In which month, according to the passage, has the rainfall been the maximum?
solution:
The correct answer is 'September.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's have a look at the third paragraph of the passage: 

 
 
• *' *Western MP has received 1,335.4 millimetres of average rainfall from June 1 to September 25, 58% more than the region’s historical normal of 845.3 mm for this period. However, the real story lies in the month-wise figures. In June, the opening month of the southwest monsoon season, the rains were actually 25.6% below the long-period average. In July, they were 31.2% above average. That surplus rose to 63.6% in August, while a whopping 158% more, so far in September.'
 
• *​*It can be concluded from the above line that* *according to the passage, **September** has the rainfall been the maximum. (यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि passage के अनुसार, सितंबर में सबसे अधिक वर्षा हुई है।).
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the correct answer is 'September.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

 
• The meaning of the word 'surplus' is* *an amount that is extra or more than you need. ('Surplus' शब्द का अर्थ है ज़रूरत से अधिक या अतिरिक्त मात्रा; बेशी।).

 
 
• Example:* The world is now producing large food **surpluses**.*
